reviews.comment: Dunlap is a phenomenal professor. Her class is super easy and asks very little from you. Pay attention during the lecture and write good notes, and you will be fine. She is very witty and cares about her students. She knows this is a 100-level course and treats it so (she makes it easy). Sadly there is a group project for this class

This class wasn't terrible, but there is a LOT of information covered that if you lack an animal science background can start to get overwhelming. However, the test questions were easy and she makes the class as doable as possible, so I would take her again.
Dunlap is like the coolest mom ever.
Really good professor. Her lectures are really straightforward, and she is very understanding. All exams are online. Few assignments and one group project which are very easy.
She is an awesome teacher. The class is not difficult. All exams are online with one group project. Dunlap is super funny and genuinely cares about her students and class

Dunlap is a fantastic professor! If you are looking for an easy life and physical science credit TAKE HER.  One group project, 4 exams plus a final (all online and very straight forward). If you come to class she will let you write exam questions - with good attendance you will know about 30% of the exam questions word for word. Good prof. Easy A.

I loved Dr. Dunlap's class! She is an awesome professor and she is very involved in the class. She wants you to participate and if you do she gives extra credit or bonus's on exams. Easy material and easy exams

Easiest class I've taken. Attendance isn't mandatory but she gives lots of extra credit so go to class! There were 4 exams, 4 assignments, and a group project. Exams are made by the students the class day before the exam so GO TO REVIEW. Partners are assigned for the project but it's easy like the assignments. She is very caring and knowledgeable!

She makes sure you understand the material and gives you many chances to ask questions and get them answered. She is clearly passionate about what she teaches but understands if you are just taking the class because you are required to. She is funny and brings life to all her lectures

Professor Dunlap is so kind and offers lots of extra credit for attending class since it is not mandatory. Lets the class make up test questions the day before the test. Adds on quizzes after the first test. Easy class. Tests online.
I loved how Dr. Dunlap taught classes and I found her lectures to be very entertaining. Easy exams that are given online so if you study, it's an easy A.

Dr. Dunlap is a great professor! This class is definitely an easy A if you do all of the assignments and extra credit. She is an easy grader, however, the only thing I would say is the tests can be a little bit difficult so just go to the reviews! Her class is super engaging and really fun! I learned a lot.
Dr. Dunlap is a great professor. She doesn't take attendance, but randomly offers extra credit for students in class. As long as you go to class and pay attention ANSC 107 is an easy A.

Dr. Dunlap is awesome! Entertaining and knowledgable, the lecture before exams you literally write the test questions so if you go to those it is hard to fail. One group project but it is easy and you have lots of time. Textbook is just copy of slides. Take this class!!!

She assigns a few assignments throughout the semester but they are very simple and straightforward. She includes a rubric for every assignment, making it easy to get full points. She also gives extra credit questions throughout lectures.

Loved having prof dunlap. Class was so enjoyable & fun and there was a packet with all the slides that was super helpful when taking notes. We reviewed by making a few exam/bonus questions. A few easy assignments & quizzes with one group project that she was very understanding with. We wrote the final exam questions as a class so it's an easy A.

Would 100% take her again very easy professor. Well, yes, there was a textbook. It was not necessary to purchase as the whole entire textbook was just the PowerPoint that she presents in class, and she makes that clear to the class before everyone buys it. All exams were online non-proctored. And only a handful of quizzes online, non-proctored.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: GO TO LECTURE. All information is given in lecture for assignments and such. review days before exams are when the class MAKES exam questions. Some days also have attendance extra credit. Very entertaining and informative lectures. Only rough part is the group project but thats because people suck and slack off. Awesome prof.

Dr. Dunlap is amazing! Tests are online, gave us many extra creds, and let us write our exam questions on review days that she included on exams. The group project was stupid but she was very understanding and communicative in class. She is kinda unorganized and hard to reach out of class but it's ok bc her class is so interesting/fun.

Professor Dunlap is super sweet and genuinely cares about her students' success! Attendance isn't mandatory however, she gives engaging lectures and has students write exam questions each class. 2+ Bonus questions for each exam, which are all online, and multiple extra credit opportunities outside of the exams. Great professor and an easy class!!

Professor Dunlap is a great professor! Attendance isn't mandatory but highly recommended because she writes test questions with the class during lectures. Some units require more studying than others, but its overall a super easy class. 3 individual assignments, 1 group project, 3 exams, and a final. Exams are online and can be taken wherever.

This class is an easy A! Prof Dunlap wants her students to succeed and allows an environment that is super easy going and comfortable. While some of the material is hard, she allows you to make test questions and pretty much tells you what you need to review. She also has extra credit within each exam- which boosts your grade so much in the end!

Dunlap is the best 107 professor, hands down. She cares for her students and accommodates their needs, makes the class understandable, and is very well knowledged in animal science. Regardless of background, she will help you learn about the different aspects of animal science. 10/10 would recommend!

Class had 4 exams, 5 hw assignments, and 1 group project. Go to class bc she gives exam questions+answers there, but there wasn't a lot to do outside of class when it came to hw. Not a hard class as long as you study a bit before tests, and I thought she was entertaining, especially when it came to repro.
Great professor take her!

Going to all the classes is a good idea since she frequently gives questions and answers to what is going to be on the test. Tests, quizzes, and the final are online. There is one group project that you'll have to do where the groups are assigned, but the project isn't difficult at all. She is nice and I would recommend taking the class.

Easy class, course consists of four exams a group project and a couple of assignments. She hardly ever responds to emails, so make sure to come into office hours if you need to reach her. Make sure to purchase textbook, exam questions are worded word for word from it.
She is a good professor and I really enjoyed her class, especially when she got talking about repro because you could see the enthusiasm guiding her.

This is the easiest class I have taken at A&M.  Pay attention and take notes and you can easily get an A. I have received 100s on all the homework because it is that easy. not really any extra credit, but she would let us come up with most of the exam questions before each exam. So easy PLEASE TAKE THIS COURSE!!!

I really liked Dr. Dunlap aside from her lack of organization. She is quite hard to reach outside of class, and it is obvious that she is busy all the time and not the best planner. However, she makes difficult material quite easy to understand in lecture. For the class, you will certainly have to study for the test or you will probably not pass.

Took this professor for Fall 2022,  in-person.
Exams are online, not proctored, 50 questions with no open-ended questions.
Very easy homework, attendance is mandatory (not graded), recommend going on days before an exam.
Textbook helpful during exams
1 Group project, you can't pick who though
All assignments online.
Has gotten better with emails.

Team taught class. So Dr. Dunlap is a great person, but you CANNOT get ahold of her outside of class. I felt like her lectures were hard to follow and it wasn't totally clear what would be on the test. I was not confident going into her test as I was the other tests. When you are able to talk to her in person she is super cool and funny!

I LOVE Dunlap! I have had her twice now and she is amazing! You can tell she truly knows what she is speaking about and makes lectures interesting. Show up to class! Dunlap makes exam questions in class and that free answers right there! 113 used Packback which I found to be annoying but that wasn't on the professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great prof! She is engaging during class and if you go she gives exam questions and answers during class, so go! On exams you are allowed to use notes and they are online. There is a group project but it can be done 100% online so its not to bad. As long as you put in effort you will get an easy A. Plus the class is very intresting!

Dr. Dunlap is a great prof, only issue for me is she's hard to reach. I emailed her multiple times and received no responses. If she offers zoom, DON'T TAKE IT, the audio is shaky or cuts out completely. There were a handful of lectures not uploaded or with no audio. Exams are open notes. Go to class, buy the book and you'll be fine.
I really liked her a lot and she is an amazing professor. Doesnt mind answering questions or clarifying things.

This was the first year this class was offered as an honors, asynchronous course. It did not go well. She barely communicated with us, hardly posted content all semester, and almost never posted things on time/when she said she would. Sure, it meant it wasnt too much work except that when she did post stuff it was HARD. Disappointing waste of time

This asynchronous honors course was incredibly inconsistent and there was an immense lack of communication on the professor's part. Everything was open-note and open-book for the sporadic assignments/tests/quizzes she gave. I have learned nothing in this class. Forgot I was even in the class until she uploaded content like 3 weeks into the semester

I feel like the prof never paid attention to this class. There were no zoom meetings or in person classes, your only grades are tests so good luck. Most of the time everyone is confused on what is going on with this class.

There is a quiz, assignment, and occasionally a discussion board due every week, but it is fairly easy. The answers to the quizzes are in the lecture slides that are posted, and there is one group project during the semester that you can hold off for a long time until actually needing to worry about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I realize that this was the 1st semester for 113, but I really feel cheated by this class because it was truly terrible. I would try to study, but I never knew what I needed to know bc the material was so unclear. No test reviews, no TAs or study guides, BARELY even office hours to help. Anyone who was struggling had nothing to help them get by :(

Dunlap is so sweet and understanding. She expects you to show up, but she works with you a lot if issues arise. She is my favorite prof so far at TAMU. She definitely knows her stuff, but she doesn't make tests too difficult. Take Dunlap!!

Excellent Professor! She was very friendly and respectful. I loved the way she included us in discussions. Made Freshman year a lot better by being understandable and helpful with literally everything. If you have the opportunity, take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class consisted of a discussion, assignment, and quiz each week. All were very easy and took very little amounts of time. I never stressed for this class. Professor Dunlap was quick to respond to emails and was a super caring lady. I would recommend her and this class to anyone needing a science credit!

There is a quiz, discussion, and activity every week. The answers to the quiz are easily found in the lecture slides. Discussion and activity are always straight forward and do not require a lot of time. If you do your work by the deadline it is hard to not make an A. No final, just a final 3 page paper. She emails back quickly too.

I took this class online and it was very easy and clear cut. Just take the notes and use the notes for quizzes and activities and complete your work on time. Very easy, she just never really graded things on time.

Dr. Dunlap was a great professor. The class overall was fairly easy. She does expect you to have more than just a basic understanding of material. Exams were scenario based - all short answer or fill in the blanks. There was a group project which was a little unorganized. Final exam grade was a reflection paper, so super easy!

Dr. Dunlap is amazing professor who puts in the effort to get to know her students. The class overall isn't very difficult but the tests can get hard if you don't know the information. Dr. Dunlap always made the class interesting and funny and didn't care if you showed up late to class. Would highly recommend this professor.
Dr. Dunlap was one of my favorites. She's very understanding and caring, if you communicate with her she is more than happy to accommodate and help you out!

*Review from AGSC major* summer 2017- It was HARD. Definitely dont skip class because her PP notes are only pictures. Also she has 11 random pop quizzes. READ THE TEXTBOOK, go to office hours and introduce yourself (just do it), ask questions, and actually study. Lab was hard, too. Study for lab practical and quizzes. Also theres 1 group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dunlap is great! I took her for 107 honors and it was not much harder than a normal class. The tests were fairly easy as long as you went to class and spent a moderate amount of time studying. There was never homework. We didn't use a textbook but there was a course pack with all the powerpoints in it.  The final was a reflection paper only. EASY

She was an awesome professor who lectured well. The book is a must have and her powerpoint slides are nothing but pictures so going to class, even though its not mandatory, is very beneficial. There are pop quizzes but she lets you use notes and the book.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Class wasn't so bad. Lab was harder because there were many quizzes and a big group project at the end. The TA's seemed to grade harder than the actual professor, though both were very nit-picky. The subject was intriguing in my opinion so I didn't have a hard time. If you go to class and print out the notes you'll be fine.

There are 11 pop quizzes throughout the semester, but only 10 of them are required. So, there is a little bit of extra credit built in. Her powerpoints are pictures only, so you have to go to lecture to get the information. Reading ahead is a must. Tests are a little hard, because there are so many pathways to memorize.

I didn't really enjoy the class. It was too easy for it to be honors in my opinion. Hardly any homework and she didn't grade assignments until the end of the year. I hated the lab, no work was required at all, the TA literally gave the answers during quizzes. Retained little to no information, good guest speakers and "field trips" though.
Took her for honors so attendance was necessary. Pretty easy class
